blocks.text:
You can copy `RefPtr`s, just like normal pointers. But
unlike normal pointers, you don't need to worry about deleting the underlying
instance.
blocks.zh: 你可以像复制普通指针一样复制RefPtr，你不需要担心删除底层实例。

blocks.text:
auto refPixbuf = Gdk::Pixbuf::create_from_file(filename);
auto refPixbuf2 = refPixbuf;

Of course this means that you can store `RefPtr`s in
standard containers, such as `std::vector` or
`std::list`.
blocks.zh: 这意味着你可以将RefPtr储存于标准容器中，例如：std::vector或std::list。
